name: Surender Ch
quote:
Was checking online to order a cake as it was my daughter's birthday. At the age of 4, most daughters are typically inclined towards princesses and castles. My daughter is no exception. So began my hunt for a princess themed cake (Frozen's Elsa cake was the demand from my daughter..sheesh). Efforts were futile and was about to give up and tell my daughter that i will be ordering a different cake, and i stumbled on this website and boy oh boy was i surprised. Prasanna gaaru was patient enough to listen to my (my daughter's) requirement and being an expert she is, she quickly had it all sorted. Right from the ingredients, the size of the cake, the delivery date etc, I had a custom image that i wanted on a cake to which she happily obliged. The payment options and all were agreed and the birthday has finally arrived. In between i was sceptical whether the kids would like the cake or not. Prasanna gaaru assured me of it and on the day of the birthday, a 3 kg cake (even though she charged me for a 2.5 kg, thanks again Prasanna gaaru) was put on the table and my daughter was so thrilled that she didn't even want to cut the cake :P. The kids loved the cake so much so that the entire cake was gone and i can see everyone (right from the kids to the adults) were smacking their lips. The best birthday party ever.. Thanks Prasanna gaaru for making this memorable!! 
 PS: Guys, cookie cream flavour  - go for it!!
